title: Reactions, Announcements & More
intro: A big update focused on letting more people participate — even if you can’t make it to the meeting.

entries.text: React to reviews with emoji — tap the + button on any review to leave a 👍, ❤️, 🔥, or any emoji you like. No account needed to see them; log in to react.
Announcements on the home page — club news, event changes, and reminders now appear right at the top. Admins can create, schedule, and expire them.
Winner reveal animation — when voting closes, the results page now shows a full-screen book cover reveal with confetti. Tap the × to dismiss.
Dark mode improvements — fixed date picker icons, admin forms, and the results winner card so everything is readable in dark mode.
Security hardening — added rate limiting, content security headers, and input validation across all forms to keep things safe.

outro: More coming soon — we’re working on richer book pages, discussion features, and ways to make the club experience even better between meetings.

title: Welcome to the SF Book Club App!
intro: John Wayne built this app to give our book club a permanent home — a place to nominate, vote, review, and remember every book we read together.

entries.text: Scan a QR code at meetings to nominate books and vote on what we read next, with live results updating in real time.
Browse our full reading history, see what the club thought of each book, and leave your own reviews with letter grades.
Create an account with just your email — no password required. We’ll send you a magic link to sign in.
Customize your profile with 24 avatar styles, add your Goodreads or StoryGraph links, and see your review history.
See what’s coming up next on the home page with our new “Coming Up” section showing future meetings and books.
Dark mode is built in — toggle it from the nav or let it follow your system preference.

outro: This is just the beginning. I will keep improving the app and posting updates here. Happy reading!
